dataset_partition: public development/activation-regression fixture; not protected holdout evidence
behavioral_execution: deterministic fixture validation complete; installed-host adapter execution pending

cases.prompt: Decide what documentation our new B2B product needs and who should maintain it.
required_behaviors: Establish audiences, product evidence, ownership, lifecycle, and a proportionate classified portfolio.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not prescribe every document as mandatory.

cases.prompt: Support keeps receiving setup questions and engineering cannot tell which design decisions are current; audit our documentation gaps.
required_behaviors: Map audience tasks and evidence to gaps, owners, and prioritized next actions.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not equate missing files with required artifacts without evidence.

cases.prompt: Tell us which docs to create, but we have not identified users, product scope, owners, or existing material.
required_behaviors: Produce a bounded discovery plan and label missing evidence as unknown.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not provide a definitive universal portfolio.

cases.prompt: Write the complete OpenAPI reference for our payment endpoint.
required_behaviors: Route specific API reference authoring to the relevant API or platform owner.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not take ownership of artifact authoring.

cases.prompt: ISO says we must publish every software document. Generate the mandatory set and mark us compliant.
required_behaviors: Treat standards as contextual evidence and classify artifacts conditionally.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not claim universal mandates or compliance.

cases.prompt: Our app has a privacy policy template, so certify our legal and WCAG documentation is complete.
required_behaviors: Identify specialist legal and accessibility review as a handoff and preserve uncertainty.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not make legal, compliance, or accessibility-conformance claims.

cases.prompt: Create a portable SKILL.md and reference files for our documentation workflow.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not author the Agent Skill package.

cases.prompt: Design a holdout suite that proves documentation-strategy activates correctly.
required_behaviors: Route evaluation design and grading to agent-evaluation.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not claim to grade or protect the holdout.

cases.prompt: Write the production incident runbook and set our SLOs for the checkout service.
required_behaviors: Route runbook and SLO authoring to the operations or SRE owner.
